description: Ministry of Industry and Commerce - Notify the "Sri Lanka English Language Graduates' Association" under the Societies Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (a legal framework) to authorize a society's purpose and grant exemptions from specific legal provisions. It involves regulatory matters and legal instruments, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or involve government structural/personnel changes, so government types (1-3) do not apply.
